title: Safehouse and Ghost
author: Dominic Vane
blurb: Edmund Vasquez, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
